title: Regulation of inflammation by Chaihu-Shugan-San: Targeting the IL-17/ NF-kappaB pathway to combat breast cancer-related depression.
authors: Qu, Zhongyuan; Li, Huimin; Qiang, Fajing; Liu, Kaili; Wu, Shuang; Li, Jianli; Zou, Xiang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 研究中药柴胡疏肝散通过IL-17/NF-kappaB通路调节小胶质细胞极化改善乳腺癌相关抑郁，分子对接仅用于鉴定中药活性成分，非蛋白质-DNA互作研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Breast cancer-related depression (BCRD) is one of the severest comorbidities, affecting the quality of life and the treatment efficacy in BC patients. Chaihu-Shugan-San (CSS), a traditional Chinese medicine presents a potential therapeutic method in BCRD. PURPOSE: The main purpose of the research was to investigate the effects of CSS on BCRD in a mouse model and to elucidate its mechanisms, particularly its impact on microglial polarization through the IL-17/ NF-kappaB pathway. METHODS: A mouse BCRD model was constructed and treated with CSS. Behavioral testing, biochemical parameters, H&E staining, and small animal imaging were used to assess the depressive-like behaviors and tumor growth in mice. RNA sequencing analysis was performed, and the data were authenticated by Western blot as well as quantitative qRT-PCR to explore the mechanisms of CSS treatment in BCRD. The BV2 microglia were stimulated with LPS in vitro and intervened by IL-17 protein, IL-17 antagonist, IMD-0354, and CSS. In addition, western blot was utilized to confirm the expression of IL-17/ NF-kappaB pathway-related factors. Molecular docking technique and UPLC-Q-TOF/MS were used to find out the key active components of CSS. RESULTS: CSS treatment significantly improved depression-like behaviors and retarded tumor growth in mice. Through RNA sequencing analysis, it was indicated that the improvement of BCRD by CSS was highly associated with the regulation of the IL-17/ NF-kappaB pathway. Western blot and qRT-PCR outcomes suggested that CSS inhibited the IL-17/ NF-kappaB pathway, facilitating the transformation from pro-inflammatory M1 microglial phenotype to anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype, contributing to the reduction of neuroinflammation. In vitro experiments demonstrated that CSS modulated the immune reaction through the induction of phenotypic transformation of microglia from M1 toward M2 phenotype, hence reducing neuroinflammation. Notably, this therapeutic effect of CSS was highly similar to the effects of IL-17 antagonists, thus suggesting that CSS alleviates the symptoms of BCRD by targeting IL-17. Molecular docking revealed that the major bioactive compounds in CSS were Saikosaponin A, Saikosaponin C, and Saikosaponin D. CONCLUSION: This study systematically demonstrates that CSS ameliorates BCRD by suppressing the IL-17/ NF-kappaB pathway as well as modulating microglial polarization and elucidates the dual function of IL-17. These results point to a new multi-target intervention strategy for BCRD treatment and fully reflect the holistic effects of CSS by its multi-component as well as multi-target actions.
abstract_zh: 背景：乳腺癌相关抑郁（BCRD）是乳腺癌（BC）患者中最严重的合并症之一，影响其生活质量及治疗效果。中药柴胡疏肝散（CSS）在BCRD中展现出潜在的治疗方法。目的：本研究的主要目的是在小鼠模型中探讨CSS对BCRD的影响，并阐明其机制，特别是通过IL-17/NF-kappaB通路对微胶质细胞极化的影响。方法：构建小鼠BCRD模型并给予CSS治疗。采用行为学测试、生化参数、H&E染色及小动物成像评估小鼠的抑郁样行为和肿瘤生长。进行RNA测序分析，并通过Western blot及定量qRT-PCR验证数据，以探讨CSS治疗BCRD的机制。体外实验中，用LPS刺激BV2微胶质细胞，并分别用IL-17蛋白、IL-17拮抗剂、IMD-0354及CSS干预。此外，利用Western blot确认IL-17/NF-kappaB通路相关因子的表达。采用分子对接技术及UPLC-Q-TOF/MS鉴定CSS的关键活性成分。结果：CSS治疗显著改善了小鼠的抑郁样行为并延缓了肿瘤生长。RNA测序分析表明，CSS改善BCRD与IL-17/NF-kappaB通路的调控高度相关。Western blot及qRT-PCR结果显示，CSS抑制IL-17/NF-kappaB通路，促进促炎性M1微胶质表型向抗炎性M2表型转化，从而减少神经炎症。体外实验证明，CSS通过诱导微胶质细胞从M1向M2表型转化来调节免疫反应，进而减轻神经炎症。值得注意的是，CSS的这种治疗效果与IL-17拮抗剂的作用高度相似，提示CSS通过靶向IL-17缓解BCRD症状。分子对接揭示CSS中的主要生物活性成分为柴胡皂苷A、柴胡皂苷C和柴胡皂苷D。结论：本研究系统证明CSS通过抑制IL-17/NF-kappaB通路及调节微胶质细胞极化来改善BCRD，并阐明了IL-17的双重功能。这些结果指向一种新的BCRD治疗多靶点干预策略，并充分体现了CSS通过其多成分及多靶点作用的整体效应。
